mathematical_reason: Stacks 7.6.1 specifies one target U, set-indexed source arrows and allows the empty index set. Index multiplicities belong to the indexed family data; collapsing to the support set of arrows changes that data. This formulation uses the Stacks small-category convention, without imposing coverage axioms.

Stacks 7.6.2 expresses its coverage through families of arrows satisfying isomorphism, transitivity/refinement and base-change axioms. This formulation records actual covering-family data rather than identifying it literally with the associated sieve-based Grothendieck topology. The Stacks category convention supplies the underlying objects and arrows.
